comments.message: Over 20. 20 runs. Bowler: Shivam Dube. Zimbabwe: 184/6(rr 9.20)

FOUR! Shivam Dube to Brian Bennett. Slower length ball, to leg on the front foot Slog, well timed in the air under control past deep mid wicket for 4 runs. India secure a commanding victory by a substantial margin, keeping their semi-final aspirations firmly intact, whilst Zimbabwe are eliminated with defeat. The Indian team delivered a complete performance, dominating proceedings with both bat and ball. Their bowlers maintained relentless pressure, striking at regular intervals, with Arshdeep Singh leading the charge with an impressive three-wicket haul. Despite a spirited chase from Zimbabwe, the target proved out of reach. Brian Bennett played a superb innings and showed great resilience, ending just short of a century but his efforts were not enough for his side to chase the sizeable target and keep their tournament alive. India meanwhile, set up a winner takes up clash with West Indies on Sunday, to decide a semi-final place. Hardik Pandya is awarded the Player of the Match for his stunning batting display.
